saw_lines: Buyers replace one broken glass, not the whole set. They check dishwasher safety and the price before they order.
So a buyer who cannot see shipping or price in the first line scrolls past, and the sale never starts.
Your site offers 15% off the first order, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it. Put that offer in the opening line of new ads and on the creative itself.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 15% off the first order, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put that offer in the opening line of new ads and on the creative itself.

Your site answers how orders ship, but 0 of 30 ads mention shipping, so buyers wonder how the glass arrives before they click. Open new ads with the shipping answer in the first line and repeat it on the creative.
Your site shows $40 and $82 prices, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so a buyer cannot judge the cost before clicking. Lead one ad with the price per glass or per plate, so the cost feels small.
0 of 30 ads carry a proof number in the copy, so an unsure buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Add a count your ads do not use yet, such as orders shipped, and open new ads with it.
